rejected_source_candidates.description: Whether plastic bags should be banned
rejected_source_candidates.reason: The counterargument about carrying bags lacks enough context to assess practical impact; the opposing arguments are not uniquely classifiable.
The proposed action ‘take steps’ is too vague to assess as a concrete, feasible course of action.
The implementation alone does not establish the programme’s purpose or assumed mechanism.
The relationship between funding and future quality is not stated; the source does not establish either conclusion.
The proposed conclusions depend on interpreting a figurative label and outside geographic/crop knowledge.

rejected_source_candidates.reason: Advice alone does not establish health benefits or a comparison with tea.
